svg.title: ProvDe review workspace: the AI-edited update is compared with its approved source, the missing receipt requirement is flagged, and the suggested wording restores it.

g.text: Help center article · AI-edited summary · 2 minutes ago
With a receipt, refunds are available
The source makes refunds depend on a
receipt. The update drops that condition,
so it reads as if no receipt is needed.
With a receipt, refunds are available
Receipt requirement restored · ready to publish
